ModMetaData.name: Fortifications - Medieval - Material / Progression: Production Patch
ModMetaData.author: Idol Of Magic
ModMetaData.description:
Compatibility patch for Fortifications - Medieval - Material and Progression: Production.
Switches Stonecrushing from Medieval to Neolithic so that Stonecutting is no longer blocked. Furthermore makes changes to pebbles, making them more viable in general. Thus this mod can be used on its own also.
Version 1.1
